login.headline: Temple seva bookings and finance, in one secure portal.
login.subline: Manage bookings and receipts, track collections and expenditure, and review month-wise financial performance.
login.feature1Desc: Super admin, admin and finance accounts, each with the right permissions
login.feature2Desc: Month-wise credits, debits and profit at a glance
login.feature3Desc: Every change is logged against the user who made it
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Krishnamath account to continue.

dashboard.title: Temple dashboard
dashboard.description: Track bookings, collections, popular sevas, and upcoming temple events from a single overview.
dashboard.popularSevasSubtitle: A quick read on booking demand.
dashboard.revenueSubtitle: Monthly financial pulse across bookings and expenditures.

bookings.title: Booking calendar
bookings.description: Click a date on the calendar to book a seva for that day, and click a booking to view its details.
bookings.allBookingsSubtitle: Click a calendar event to view booking details. Use the table below for a complete list.
bookings.noBookingsForDay: No active bookings for this day.
bookings.upiScanSubtitle: Scan the QR code with any UPI app to complete the payment.
bookings.upiOpenHint: Open the QR code for the devotee to scan and pay.
bookings.upiDummyBadge: Sample QR — replace with the temple's actual UPI QR
bookings.formSubtitle: Fill in the devotee and seva details to issue a receipt.
bookings.emptyText: Bookings will appear here once created.
bookings.dateLockedHint: Set from the calendar date you clicked.
bookings.searchPlaceholder: Search receipt, devotee, mobile, seva, date, amount…
bookings.cancelWarning: The amount {{amount}} will be removed from the accounts and the receipt will be marked CANCELLED. A refund, if you pay one out, has to be recorded separately. This cannot be undone.
bookings.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this booking being cancelled?
bookings.cancelClosedHint: A booking can be cancelled only up to its seva date ({{date}}). That date has passed, so this booking is frozen.
bookings.cancelDeadlineNote: You can cancel this booking until the end of its seva date ({{date}}).

sevas.title: Seva management
sevas.catalogSubtitle: Browse the complete seva list, search across fields, and move through pages of results.
sevas.searchPlaceholder: Search by seva, category, description, or status
sevas.addDesc: Create a seva entry without leaving the catalog view.
sevas.emptyText: No sevas match the current search.

expenditures.title: Expenditure management
expenditures.description: Track outgoing temple expenses, classify spending, and compare operational outflow against booking revenue.
expenditures.emptyText: No expenditures have been entered yet.
expenditures.searchPlaceholder: Search title, category, vendor, date, amount…

reports.title: Reports and audit
reports.description: Review collection summaries, payment-mode performance, seva-wise revenue, and recent audit trail entries.
reports.noSevaRevenue: No seva revenue for this period.
reports.noBookings: No bookings found for the selected period.

metadata.title: Metadata management
metadata.description: Manage master data entries used across the booking and reporting workflows.
metadata.name: Name

roles.super-adminDesc: Full access: configuration, bookings, expenditure, finance and user management.
roles.adminDesc: Configures sevas and metadata, creates bookings and records expenditure.
roles.financeDesc: Read-only access to payments, expenditure, reports and the finance dashboard.

finance.overviewDescription: Month-wise credits, debits and profit for the selected year.
finance.monthlyTrendHint: Credits are stacked by category. Cancelled receipts are excluded.
finance.paymentsDescription: Every receipt grouped under the way it was paid, with its category. Filter by category to reconcile each head.
finance.expendituresDescription: Expenditure for the selected period, grouped by category.
finance.noExpenditures: No expenditure recorded in this period.
finance.exportEmpty: No receipts in this period to export.

users.title: Users & roles
users.description: Create staff accounts, assign roles and reset passwords.
users.selfHint: You cannot change your own role or deactivate your own account.

receipts.title: Annadana, donation & hundi
receipts.description: Record payments received other than seva bookings. Seva bookings are accounted under Religious Seva automatically.
receipts.empty: No receipts recorded for this period.
receipts.confirmCancel: Cancel receipt {{number}}? It will be removed from the accounts but kept in the audit trail.
receipts.searchPlaceholder: Search receipt, devotee, mobile, category, notes…

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Update your own details and password. Your role is managed by a super admin.
profile.infoDescription: How you appear in the portal and in the audit trail.
profile.name: Full name
profile.emailHint: This is also what you use to sign in.
profile.confirmWithPassword: Enter your current password to change your email address
profile.roleHint: Your role and account status can only be changed by a super admin.
profile.passwordDescription: Use at least 10 characters. You will stay signed in on this device.
profile.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match

blockedDates.title: Blocked dates
blockedDates.description: Days on which no seva bookings are accepted, for example Ekadashi, when the sevas are performed at the temple itself. Blocked days are marked on the booking calendar and cannot be booked.
blockedDates.reasonLabel: Reason for the dates you block
blockedDates.tapHint: Click a day to block it with the reason above. Click a blocked day to open it for bookings again.
blockedDates.existingWarning: {{count}} existing booking(s) on {{date}} were not cancelled. Contact those devotees if needed.
blockedDates.loadFailed: Could not load the blocked dates
blockedDates.empty: No dates are blocked for this year yet.

sevaList.title: Priest's seva list
sevaList.description: The sevas to be performed today and tomorrow, with each devotee's name, gotra, nakshatra and raashi, ready to hand over to the priest as a PDF.
sevaList.name: Name
sevaList.empty: No sevas are booked for this day.
sevaList.blockedNote: {{reason}}: bookings are closed for this day
sevaList.searchPlaceholder: Search name, gotra, nakshatra or seva…
sevaList.loadFailed: Could not load the seva list
